verdict.rationale: Bento can be driven entirely without its UI. It documents a CLI with 50+ commands covering imports, tags, events, broadcasts and transactional sends, plus a REST API using publishable/secret-key Basic auth, many first-party SDKs, and an explicit pitch to 'script the job you run every week.' Together these support scripted, headless automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (non-interactive CLI mode, env-var credential setup, pipeline examples) and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
